_comment: Stage 6 eight-model checkpoint-lock template. Consumed by scripts/build_lock_stage5.py --template. The A2 trio (miflu/notext/nlinear) is listed so a single lock covers the whole eight-model comparison; notext is a mechanism control, not one of the eight.

fidelity_labels.patchtst: PatchTST-INSPIRED: supervised, no RevIN, no self-supervised pretraining, reduced capacity (d_model=64, 2 layers). NOT canonical PatchTST.
fidelity_labels.miflu: corrected reconstruction of MIFlu (text path live, validation-selected)
fidelity_labels.qwen_time_llm: Time-LLM-INSPIRED: frozen Qwen2.5-1.5B, patch prototype reprogramming, Prompt-as-Prefix
fidelity_labels.calf_llm: CALF-INSPIRED: frozen GPT-2, parallel temporal/text branches, 2 alignment losses
fidelity_labels.timecma_llm: TimeCMA-INSPIRED: frozen GPT-2, retrieval alignment, last-token branch
